title: x402 Clean Index: weekly demand-cleaned x402 agent payments on Base (data, code and working paper)
description:
A weekly index of what buyers, mostly AI agents, pay for on the x402 HTTP-payment protocol on Base, after removing provably manufactured volume (self-payments, closed payment loops, funding-linked payer–seller pairs, fan-out manufacture) and single-buyer dust, with every seller classified as content, data, search, compute or other. Includes the weekly series (data/x402_index/weekly.csv), posted and paid prices per call (prices_weekly.csv), per-seller weekly figures (payees_weekly.csv), the seller leaderboard (data/x402_sellers/), the compact pipeline state that rebuilds every number offline (state/), the method note (docs/X402_INDEX_METHOD.md), the working paper (paper/), and the agent purchase-decision benchmark (data/agentbuy/).

Sources: public Base chain data via Blockscout; the Coinbase CDP Bazaar discovery listing. Updated every Monday at https://wknipe.com/x402/. Data and text: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT (see LICENSE in the archive).
notes: Cleaned figures are an upper bound on genuine demand: the manufacture filters remove only what they can prove. See docs/X402_INDEX_METHOD.md for every filter and known bias.
